paper_style.palette_strategy: 定量曲线主要使用固定的蓝—橙模型 palette；Figure 7 使用蓝/橙/绿表示训练长度，Figure 8–9 使用浅蓝/棕橙/绿/深红表示 mixture weight。Figure 1/2/4 的 trajectory/graph 卡片另用 pastel 语义色；表格保持黑白 booktabs 与粗体最佳单元。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: PDF 字体对象显示 Nimbus Roman/Computer Modern 正文与 DejaVu Sans 图表。pdfimages -list 显示 p.2 一个小 JPEG 图标、p.20 两个 PNG screenshot、p.26 一个 3569×1469 RGB raster（约 811 dpi）；其余图表以矢量路径/文字渲染。
paper_style.style_consistency: 正文与表格的 Nimbus Roman/Computer Modern 体系稳定；quantitative charts 的 DejaVu Sans、固定 marker 和网格风格大体一致。Figure 8/9 跨图 palette 一致，Figure 1/4 的概念图和 raster screenshot 引入局部字体/颜色；caption 的统计定义与 Figure 6 工具描述存在局部不一致。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: We finetune Mamba and Pythia (Transformer) on trajectories collected from different tool-use agents for solving a coding problem. 1) Single-Turn Tool-Use: Hard-coded agent that prints all the files in the repository and then outputs all the required changes. 2) Interactive Tool-Use: Hard-coded agent that iteratively runs the code, changes a few files, runs the code again etc. until all problems are resolved. 3) Distillation: SWE-agent Language Model (Yang et al., 2025) instructed to solve the bug in the code. Models are trained on codebases of up to 16 files (dashed red line), with context length 8K, and evaluated on larger codebases with longer context. While Pythia outperforms Mamba on smaller codebases and single-turn tool use, Mamba displays favorable performance on large codebases when trained to imitate interactive agents (agents 2 and 3), extrapolating beyond the training distribution.

color.semantic_mapping: 黑色为文字/边框，#376380 与 #BF572E 分别编码 Mamba/Pythia，#F08080 为 16-function 训练上限，#B0B0B0 为网格；粉、绿、浅蓝卡片分别承载 command、observation 与提示/对话块。

encodings.line: Single-Turn dotted; Interactive dashed; Distillation solid
encodings.facet: three trajectory illustrations plus right result chart

figures.data_and_statistics: Code-fixing pass rate as codebase function count grows. Models train on codebases up to 16 files and context 8K, then are evaluated on larger codebases; Pythia is stronger on small/single-turn cases, while Mamba declines more slowly for interactive/distillation trajectories. No error bars, seed decomposition, test denominator, or failure count is shown; the training corpus is filtered to correct and short trajectories in §3.3.
figures.evidence_relation: Introduction bounded-memory claim → §3.3 code-fixing dependency graph and three trajectory collectors → Figure 1 strategy/length comparison → Appendix E prompt and Figure 10 agent statistics. This is headline and experimental-interface evidence, not a component ablation.
design_strengths: Three trajectory sources and their result curves share one visual frame.
The 16-function training limit is a salient red reference line.
The caption defines agents, training boundary, evaluation extension, and the direction of the main comparison.
design_weaknesses: Six curves rely on small color/line-style legend entries.
The three diagram blocks consume area, making exact curve values difficult to read.
Successful/short-trajectory filtering, best-seed aggregation, denominators, and exact large-codebase range are absent from the caption.
figures.reusable_pattern: Pair local trajectory cards with an extrapolation curve on the same strategy vocabulary, adding a training-boundary reference line and a self-contained caption.

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2: Left: Illustration of an interactive tool-use agent trajectory with pointer-based memory tool for solving multi-digit addition. The agent can generate thoughts (blue), outputs (purple) or commands (orange), and receive observations (green) from the memory tool. At each step, we show the state of the memory context on the top row, and below it show the sequence of generated tokens. Right: Accuracy of recurrent/SSM models (Mamba, LSTM, GRU) and Transformers (Pythia, Mistral) trained on trajectories for ≤ 5-digit addition, evaluated on up to 1,000-digits (log scale).

color.semantic_mapping: 图表三种蓝色对应 Mamba/LSTM/GRU、两种橙色对应 Pythia/Mistral；轨迹中浅黄为输入 token、浅蓝为 thought/state、粉橙为 command、绿色为 observation、紫色为 output，红色为 pointer label，灰色为省略/中性块。

encodings.x: right: sequence length on log scale; left: generated token step
encodings.line: solid model curves; pointer arrows in trajectory
encodings.facet: left trajectory trace and right accuracy chart
encodings.text: Step, pointer, commands, observations, sum/carry, legend

figures.data_and_statistics: Exact recovery of the desired addition trajectory and final answer. Training uses trajectories for ≤5-digit addition and evaluation reaches 1,000 digits; Mamba/LSTM remain near perfect in the shown range, Pythia/Mistral collapse after short lengths, and GRU falls to about 0.8 at the longest point. No error band, repeated-run summary, denominator, or seed aggregation is plotted; the text says lengths beyond 1,000 were not measured.
figures.evidence_relation: §2.2 external-memory protocol → Theorem 2.2 constructive mechanism → Figure 2 left pointer trace and right addition experiment → §3.1 and Appendix D.1/D.3 token/algorithm definitions; Appendix D.7 supplies no-tool and single-turn ablations.
design_strengths: Four temporal slices make pointer reads and generated context visible.
The log x-axis exposes three orders of magnitude of length.
The caption defines token-role colors, model groups, and train/evaluation ranges.
design_weaknesses: The short trace cannot display long-run memory behavior.
Five markers and a small legend are dense at page scale, while the chart has no uncertainty or denominator.
Exact-recovery aggregation is defined in surrounding text rather than in the caption.
figures.reusable_pattern: Pair an executable memory-interface trace with the same interface’s length curve, using role colors, model markers, and a log scale.

figures.label: Figure 3

caption.text: Figure 3: Accuracy of Pythia and Mamba trained on in-context datasets with 5 examples, evaluated on up to 25 examples.

color.semantic_mapping: 蓝色为 Mamba (1.4B)，橙色为 Pythia (1.4B)，黑色为文字/轴，灰色为网格和边界。两模型使用相同圆形 marker，主要依赖颜色。

figures.data_and_statistics: Models train on in-context trajectories with up to 5 examples and are evaluated at 5–25 examples on a representative Oolong/Yahoo Answers task. Rendered points are about 0.85 for both at 5 examples, about 0.65 vs. 0.59 at 25 examples (Mamba vs. Pythia). No error bars, seed information, denominator, or failure values are shown.
figures.evidence_relation: §3.4 extends the synthetic/coding length-generalization comparison to one Oolong natural-language task slice; Figure 3 supports the finite observation that the models are similar in-distribution while Mamba retains higher accuracy on longer datasets.
design_strengths: Discrete context points and a common y-axis make the OOD gap easy to scan.
The compact legend identifies model size and family.
design_weaknesses: Only one representative task is shown.
The caption omits task semantics, denominator, repetitions, and uncertainty.
Identical circle markers and solid lines leave color as the main series cue.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use a compact fixed-context OOD curve, while adding task definition, train/evaluation boundary, denominator, and repetition details to the caption.

encodings.x: 无数值 x 轴；位置表示 graph→code 转换
encodings.y: 无数值 y 轴；上下行表示任务类型
encodings.color: 输入/中间/输出节点与代码语法角色
encodings.shape: 圆形节点、定向箭头、代码框/截图

figures.data_and_statistics: Conceptual task construction. The upper DAG uses k=3 input nodes and Boolean AND/OR/negation expressions; the lower graph shows main→foo code dependencies and file/code views. It reports no sample, aggregate statistic, denominator, or uncertainty.
figures.evidence_relation: §3.2 Logical Graph and §3.3 Code Fixing definitions → Figure 4 graph/code representations → Appendix D.2 random DAG and Appendix E prompt; Figure 1 reuses the coding dependency setting and Table 1/Figure 6 evaluate the graph task.
design_strengths: The paired rows map abstract graphs to executable code representations.
Direct node labels and directed edges expose the Boolean/function dependency structure.
The graph→code arrows provide a clear method interface.
design_weaknesses: No legend explains the color roles; readers must use position and surrounding text.
The raster editor/file-list screenshot is dense at single-column size.
Caption omits search-tool semantics, bug variable, and graph-size parameters.

figures.label: Figure 5
figures.module: Appendix D.4 Tower of Hanoi Experiment Details

caption.text: Figure 5: Performance of different seeds when training a Mamba model on Tower of Hanoi puzzles with up to 8 disks.

color.semantic_mapping: All ten seed trajectories share #1F77B4; black is axis/text, #B0B0B0 grid, and white background. Seed identity has no color or line-style redundancy.

figures.data_and_statistics: Ten Mamba seeds trained on puzzles up to 8 disks are plotted at 7–12 disks with exact accuracy. The text notes token accuracy ≥99.75% at 12 disks while exact accuracy varies strongly by seed. No aggregate, seed label, denominator, or failure type is shown.
figures.evidence_relation: Appendix D.4 explains exponential Hanoi outputs and seed sensitivity; Figure 5 expands Table 1’s best-seed summary into seed-wise robustness evidence and contrasts with Table 2’s recursive variant.
design_strengths: All seeds remain visible, preventing a single best curve from hiding variability.
The training boundary at 8 disks is easy to compare with OOD points 9–12.
design_weaknesses: No seed IDs or legend make overlapping curves impossible to trace.
Exact and token-level accuracy require surrounding prose to distinguish.
figures.reusable_pattern: When initialization sensitivity threatens a best-seed summary, plot every seed and state metric, train boundary, seed count, and uncertainty in the caption.

figures.label: Figure 6
figures.module: Appendix D.5 SSMs and Transformer Baselines

caption.text: Figure 6: We train various transformer (Pythia, Mistral) and SSM (Mamba, LSTM, GRU) models on Multi-Digit Multiplication, Logical Graph and Tower of Hanoi tasks, with CoT + pointer-based memory tool. Multi-Digit Multiplication: We train models on multiplying a number of up to 10-digit by a 1-digit number or 2-digit number, using the pointer-based memory tool. Logical Graph: We train models to perform a logical graph reasoning problem using search-based memory tool, training on graphs with up to 10 variables. Tower of Hanoi: We train models to solve the Tower of Hanoi (recursive implementation) reasoning problem using search-based memory tool, training on problems with up to 7 disks. The first point in each plot is the maximal problem size seen during training (i.e., all other points are out-of-distribution extrapolation).

color.semantic_mapping: 固定五模型 palette：Mamba #376380、LSTM #4782A6、GRU #7FB1D1、Pythia #BF572E、Mistral #E37944；黑/灰/白承担文字、网格和背景。

encodings.x: sequence length (log) in three panels; # of Discs in Hanoi panel
encodings.facet: multiplication ×1, multiplication ×2, Logical Graph, recursive Hanoi

figures.data_and_statistics: Multiplication trains first operand up to 10 digits with second operand 1 or 2 digits; Logical Graph trains up to 10 variables; recursive Hanoi trains up to 7 disks. First point in each panel is the maximal training size; later points are OOD. Accuracy curves have no seed, denominator, error bar, or failure breakdown.
figures.evidence_relation: Table 1 synthetic summary → Figure 6 complete multiplication/Logical Graph/recursive Hanoi baseline curves → Appendix D.3/D.4 algorithms. It adds curve detail that the main table’s maximum-length summary omits.
design_strengths: Shared model colors/markers make four task panels cross-comparable.
Log x axes expose multiplicative length expansion in arithmetic/graph tasks.
The caption explicitly defines the first-point training boundary.
design_weaknesses: Repeated legends consume much of the four-panel canvas.
The caption opens with pointer-based memory, then specifies search-based memory for Logical Graph and Hanoi.
Best-seed choice, denominators, and exact/token metric definitions are absent.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use a fixed model palette and marker system for a multi-task baseline atlas, mark the training boundary in each panel, and name each tool interface explicitly.

figures.label: Figure 7
figures.module: Appendix D.6 Ablating Training Steps and Digit Length for Multiplication

caption.text: Figure 7: Multiplication generalization performance for Mamba across different training configurations. Each subplot shows accuracy as a function of sequence length for a specific maximum training steps value. Different colored lines represent different training sequence lengths, with error envelope indicating median absolute discrepancy across 5 runs.

color.semantic_mapping: train_len=5/10/20 分别用蓝/橙/绿；同色半透明 envelope 表示对应曲线的跨 run discrepancy，黑/灰/白承担轴、网格和背景。

figures.data_and_statistics: Mamba is compared across train_len 5/10/20 and max_steps 250/500/800. Shaded envelopes encode median absolute discrepancy across 5 runs. The plotted pattern is greater OOD stability for train_len=20 and for larger budgets, with shorter training lengths degrading at long sequence lengths; no point-level denominator is shown.
figures.evidence_relation: §3.1 task-mixture/training-budget question → Appendix D.6 steps × digit-length ablation → Figure 7. It supplies configuration stability behind the main Table 1/Section 3 claims.
design_strengths: The 2×3 grid crosses task, budget, and train length systematically.
Envelopes expose run-to-run spread rather than only a selected curve.
The log x-axis reaches the 1000-length test range.
design_weaknesses: Task 1/Task 2 are not defined in the caption.
Legend placement changes by panel and repeats 18 entries.
The envelope says median absolute discrepancy without defining its upper/lower construction.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use a regular facet grid for budget × training-length × task, keep color/marker roles fixed, and define the uncertainty envelope mathematically.

figures.label: Figure 8

caption.text: Figure 8: Multiplication task accuracy under co-training with varying training budgets (see Sec 3.1).

color.semantic_mapping: w=0.0/0.33/0.5/0.6 使用浅蓝、棕橙、绿、深红；marker 与颜色共同编码 weight，黑/灰/白承担文字、网格和背景。

plot_grammar.legend_placement: inside each panel; first upper-right, others lower-left

figures.data_and_statistics: Primary multiplication is co-trained with auxiliary addition; w=0 is main-task-only and higher w is normalized auxiliary-sample fraction. Budgets are 250/500/800 steps. At 250 steps curves fall quickly, at 500 steps some weights retain long-range accuracy while w=0.6 collapses at large lengths, and at 800 steps most settings remain high. Error bars represent random-seed variability, without seed count or test denominator.
figures.evidence_relation: §3.1 task-mixture claim → Figure 8 primary multiplication view → Figure 9 auxiliary addition companion; Appendix D.8 defines budget, weight, and error bars.
design_strengths: Common y-axis and three budget facets expose the training-budget effect.
Error bars make seed variability visible.
Weight palette and marker roles are stable across Figure 8 and Figure 9.
design_weaknesses: The caption delegates budget, weight, and error-bar definitions to preceding prose.
Intermediate-budget weight-specific collapse is hard to read at page scale.
Mixture counts, seed number, and aggregation are omitted.
figures.reusable_pattern: Hold the primary task fixed while faceting training budgets and mixture weights, using error bars to show the boundary between synergy and instability.

figures.label: Figure 9

caption.text: Figure 9: Addition task accuracy under co-training with varying training budgets (250, 500, 800 steps). Curves show different mixing weights. See (3.1).

color.semantic_mapping: 与 Figure 8 相同：w=0.0/0.33/0.5/0.6 以浅蓝、棕橙、绿、深红编码，marker 提供冗余；黑/灰/白为文字、网格、背景。

figures.data_and_statistics: Auxiliary addition accuracy under the same co-training weights and budgets as Figure 8. w=0 remains near zero, while w>0 curves are generally high with long-length/budget-dependent declines; error bars represent random-seed variability. No seed count, sample denominator, interval, or failure category is provided.
figures.evidence_relation: Figure 8 primary multiplication curves → Figure 9 auxiliary addition capability → Appendix D.8 shared-structure/task-mixture explanation. Together they show both the primary-task benefit and the auxiliary task exposure.
design_strengths: Identical facet structure and palette make Figure 8/9 comparisons immediate.
The w=0 near-zero auxiliary baseline clarifies what auxiliary exposure contributes.
design_weaknesses: Repeated legends and long-length error bars crowd the small panels.
`See (3.1)` is a weak standalone pointer, and the caption omits the error-bar definition.
Actual mixture counts, seeds, and test denominators are absent.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use paired primary/auxiliary plots with identical facets and palette so task synergy and task-specific learnability can be read together.

figures.label: Figure 10
figures.module: Appendix E Code Fixing Agent Setup

caption.text: Figure 10: Pass rate and median sequence length for SWE-agent-LM-32B on the code fixing task.

color.semantic_mapping: 嵌入图像中蓝/绿/红分别编码 Min/Average/Max Length，红色也用于右侧 pass-rate 系列；灰色网格与浅灰背景、白色画布承担结构。左侧 marker 形状补充颜色。

plot_grammar.legend_placement: left panel center-right; none on right

encodings.y: left: Sequence Length (tokens); right: Pass Rate (%)
encodings.color: Min blue, Average green, Max red; right pass-rate red

figures.data_and_statistics: SWE-agent-LM-32B code-fixing trajectories over codebases with 4–16 functions. Minimum/average/maximum trajectory lengths rise overall (maximum roughly 10k to 28–30k tokens); pass rate declines from about 79.5% at 4 functions to about 61.5% at 16 with local rebounds. No trajectory count, denominator, seed, or uncertainty is shown. Appendix E text calls the plotted length “generated trajectory length,” while the caption says median and the legend says Average.
figures.evidence_relation: §3.3 codebase complexity and trajectory filtering → Appendix E mini-SWE-agent prompt/workflow → Figure 10 agent length/pass-rate statistics → Figure 1 Mamba/Pythia finetuning curves. This is setup/failure evidence, not a final-model comparison.
design_strengths: The two panels share function count, pairing generation burden with pass rate.
Min/average/max markers and the right pass-rate curve make the complexity trend visible.
design_weaknesses: Caption says median sequence length while the legend says Average Length.
The embedded raster is less stable for fine ticks and legend text at page zoom.
Pass-rate denominator, trajectory filter fraction, and uncertainty are absent.
figures.reusable_pattern: Pair cost/trajectory-length statistics with success rate on a common complexity axis, and state mean/median, denominators, and filtering consistently.

tables.label: Table 1

caption.text: Table 1: Experimental results for synthetic tasks for different models. The notation n → m(p%) means a model trained on length n achieves accuracy p on length m (for the largest m s.t. p ≥ 5%).

tables.uncertainty: Point results only. No SD/SE, interval, test denominator, or failure count; footnote 7 states 10 seeds for Mamba/Pythia Hanoi and 3 for other models, with the best-performing seed reported.
tables.data_and_statistics: Rows are Mamba, LSTM, GRU, Pythia, and Mistral. Columns are n×1, n×2, Logical Graph, and Hanoi⁷. Cells report training length → largest evaluated length with accuracy in parentheses, selected at p≥5%; exact cell values are transcribed from the PDF in the Markdown audit.
tables.evidence_relation: §3.1 multiplication and Logical Graph plus §3.2 Hanoi → unified largest-length/p≥5% summary. Figure 2 covers addition, Figure 6 expands baseline curves, and Table 2 expands recursive Hanoi.
design_strengths: A fixed n→m(p%) syntax compresses train length, extrapolation length, and accuracy.
Four tasks share one comparison surface.
A horizontal rule separates SSM/RNN rows from Transformer rows.
design_weaknesses: The maximum-length threshold hides full curves and seed heterogeneity.
The Hanoi superscript/footnote is easy to miss, and the table has no cost, failure, or uncertainty columns.
tables.reusable_pattern: Define one train-length → largest-test-length (accuracy) notation and disclose threshold, aggregation, and seed rules in the caption.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.module: Appendix D.4 Tower of Hanoi Experiment Details

caption.text: Table 2: Experimental results for the Tower of Hanoi puzzle solved recursively by different models.

tables.uncertainty: Point exact-solution accuracy only. No seed dispersion, repetitions, denominator, interval, or token-level failure summary is shown.
tables.data_and_statistics: Recursive Hanoi rows: Mamba 7→8 (100%), LSTM 7→9 (83%), GRU 7→8 (100%), Pythia 7→7 (100%), and Mistral 7→8 (87%). The notation is inherited from Table 1; recursive output length and exact-match criteria are defined in Appendix D.3/D.4.
tables.evidence_relation: Appendix D.3 recursive algorithm → Table 2 recursive results → Figure 6 recursive baseline curves; Figure 5 separately shows iterative Mamba seed sensitivity.
design_strengths: The small table directly exposes the only model reaching 9 disks in the recursive setting.
The same compact notation makes it comparable with Table 1.
design_weaknesses: The notation and recursive/iterative distinction are not self-contained.
The table omits exponential output length, seed counts, and the token-vs-exact metric distinction.
tables.reusable_pattern: Reuse the main notation for an appendix algorithm variant, but add variant, metric, seed, and output-length definitions to the header/caption.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 先绑定三种 coding trajectory 与外推曲线，Figure 2 展示 pointer-memory 机制与 addition 结果，Table 1 统一 synthetic 外推摘要，Figure 3 扩展到自然语言，Figure 4–10 展开任务构造、seed、baseline、训练配置与 agent setup；叙事主线是有限内部状态→外部工具接口→轨迹学习→长度外推。
cross_object_system.caption_system: Figure 1/2 caption 相对完整，Figure 3 过短；Figure 6/7 给出设置细节，Figure 8/9 依赖前置段落，Figure 10 的 median/average 术语冲突。Table 1 自带 notation/threshold 定义，Table 2 复用该 notation 却未重述。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: 两表均以 Model 和 n→m(p%) 结果语法为核心，横线分隔 recurrent/SSM 与 Transformer，黑白 booktabs 配合粗体最佳单元；Table 2 缺少 recursive/iterative algorithm-variant 层级。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 2/4 承担 method interface；Figure 1/3、Table 1、Figure 6 承担主比较；Figure 5/7/8/9 承担 robustness/ablation；Figure 10 承担 agent setup/failure。Figure 6 caption 的 pointer/search tool 用语是最明显的跨对象接口冲突。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 正文 p.7–10 通过 Appendix C/D/E/F 指针后移训练超参、tool algorithms、seed sensitivity、ablation、Hybrid/RMT 和 coding prompt。Table 1 的 best-seed 聚合需要与 Figure 5 的 all-seed 展开对照。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: 正文使用 Nimbus Roman/Computer Modern；图表使用 DejaVu Sans；轨迹和 screenshot 使用 Lucida Console、Aptos 或 raster 内字体。Figure 2/6 的模型 palette 与 Figure 7/8/9 的 facet typography 基本稳定，概念图的混合字体较多。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Figure 2/6 共享蓝—橙五模型语义，Figure 7 使用蓝/橙/绿训练长度，Figure 8/9 共享 mixture weight palette。多数 quantitative plots 主要依赖颜色，Figure 2/6/7/8/9 用 marker 提供冗余；Figure 5 的十条 seed 线没有身份冗余。

most_reusable_patterns: 工具 trajectory 的局部状态与共享 x 轴长度曲线配对，沿接口—行为—结果阅读。
在 Table 1 中固定 n→m(p%) 与 p≥5% 规则，并公开聚合阈值。
用 Figure 5 seed-wise lines、Figure 7 envelope、Figure 8/9 error bars 分别暴露初始化、训练配置和 task-mixture 不稳定性。
用 Figure 4 的抽象 graph→code 双行结构表达 synthetic task 构造。
highest_value_objects: Figure 2：同时连接 pointer-memory interface、addition headline 与 Theorem 2.2 机制。
Table 1：统一压缩 arithmetic/reasoning 外推结果，便于和 Figure 6/附录互证。
Figure 1：把三种 coding trajectory source 与 system-level Mamba/Pythia 差异绑定。
Figure 5：把 best-seed 汇总还原为 seed heterogeneity，揭示 Hanoi 边界。
failure_patterns: 分母、seed 聚合与 uncertainty 只在部分对象出现。
Table 1 的最大长度/best-seed 摘要隐藏完整曲线和 Hanoi 异质性。
Figure 6 caption 对 Logical Graph/Hanoi 的 pointer-based 与 search-based tool 描述冲突。
Figure 7 的 Task 1/2、Figure 8/9 的 weight/error-bar 细节依赖正文。
Figure 10 caption 的 median 与 legend 的 Average 不一致，且对象为 raster。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文以工具轨迹示意→统一长度外推比较→附录 seed/预算/任务构造展开的顺序，把外部状态解除 SSM 记忆瓶颈转成可扫描的证据链；统计聚合、工具接口和 uncertainty 定义仍需统一。
